name: The Howling Hand
summary: Resistance to lightning and thunder, and Lightning Bolt once a Long Rest. The price: Disadvantage on Stealth checks and on Wisdom saving throws.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's (the breached vault's X33d); the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_breached_vault (the breached vault off the vault stair).

benefit.text: A storm waits in your hands, and the sky's own fury runs off you like rain.

cost.flaw: The air round you smells of rain and crackles when you move, and the storm's temper has come with it.
cost.text: The storm's wildness leaves your thoughts too loose to hold steady when someone tries to bend them, and you cannot creep up on anyone again.
